items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Oh, he was a character if there ever was one; Freddie the Freeloader.

ctx.x: Freddie the Freeloader! He was a character.
Oh, he was a character if there ever was one; Freddie the Freeloader.
Oh, he'd bring my bass in on a date and he'd sit there and he'd have a few tastes -- he'd be the first one at the bar; before you ordered yours, he had already ordered and he said it was on you.
